name: Paid media weekly reporting across ad platforms
query: A 14-person paid media agency spends every Monday pulling Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, HubSpot, and Klaviyo data into custom client reports. Account managers lose 18 hours per week and reports are sometimes late.

name: SEO onboarding and reporting setup drag
query: An SEO agency manually creates GA4 and Google Search Console access requests, keyword research docs, technical audit tasks, and reporting spreadsheets for every new client kickoff.

name: Recurring retainer invoicing and dunning
query: A full-service agency manually checks retainers, creates monthly Stripe invoices, follows up on failed payments, handles currency conversion, and reconciles invoice status in the CRM.

name: API rate limits and pagination recovery
query: An n8n workflow backfills thousands of CRM records through an API, hits rate limits, retries from the wrong cursor, and creates duplicate records after pagination drift.

name: n8n queue mode, monitoring, and performance
query: A self-hosted n8n instance runs too many concurrent workflows, stores large execution data, processes binary files in memory, and needs queue mode workers, Redis, pruning, monitoring, and backup planning.

name: Inbound lead routing by budget and service interest
query: A marketing agency gets inbound leads from forms and LinkedIn. The founder manually checks budget, service interest, UTM source, and assigns the lead to the right specialist with an SLA follow-up.

name: Client health scoring and churn detection
query: An agency wants a weekly client health score from NPS, response time, performance results, billing status, renewal date, and support tickets so account managers can intervene before churn.

name: Agency capacity planning and utilization
query: A 25-person agency has projects, PTO, pipeline deals, role estimates, and inconsistent time tracking. Leadership needs weekly capacity planning before accepting new work.

name: HubSpot and delivery system drift
query: HubSpot has sales data but delivery status lives in Airtable and Asana. Updates drift, associations are wrong, and the team needs a reconciliation workflow with change detection.

name: AI drafted client-facing output with approval
query: The agency wants AI to draft client emails, status narratives, and report summaries, but anything client-facing must pause for approval and include confidence scoring.
